# xyops_workflow (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "xyops_workflow" "example" {
  title    = "Example Workflow"
  enabled  = true
  category = "general"
  tags     = []
  triggers = jsonencode([])
  actions  = jsonencode([])
  limits   = jsonencode([])
  workflow = jsonencode({
    nodes = [
      { id = "start", type = "event", event = "shellplug", x = 10, y = 10 }
    ]
    connections = []
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `title` (String)
- `workflow` (String)

### Optional

- `actions` (String)
- `category` (String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `limits` (String)
- `tags` (List of String)
- `triggers` (String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import xyops_workflow.example example
```
